MLBB meta in November 2026: hero tier list from official statistics

Season 42 tier list from 30 days of official statistics: strongest heroes, bans, popular and weak heroes, and how Mythical Glory differs.

In this story

  1. Hero tier list for November 2026
  2. The strongest heroes of the month
  3. Who gets banned the most
  4. Popular but not the strongest
  5. What changes in Mythical Glory
  6. The weakest heroes right now
← All news

In brief

In short

  • Masha has the best 30-day win rate at 60.47%, but she appears in only 0.52% of matches.
  • Hirara is banned the most: in 68.00% of matches across all ranks and 86.53% in Mythical Glory.
  • Hanabi is the most picked hero (2.43%), while Tigreal wins only 45.20% at a 2.00% pick rate.
  • Franco, Fanny and Granger are the weakest right now, with 41.57% to 43.00% wins.

We built the Season 42 meta from MOONTON’s official statistics: the Hero Rank section on mobilelegends.com shows the pick, win and ban rate of every hero. We took the last 30 days across all ranks, with data updated on 21 November 2026 at 23:55. We also compared it with Mythical Glory, where the game is played differently from the average.

B49–51%33Cecilion, Zetian, Alice, Kalea, Beatrix, Eudora, Clint, Moskov, Aamon, Badang, Vale, Ixia, Paquito, Hirara, Brody, Angela, Julian, X.Borg, Kaja, Miya, Suyou, Nolan, Odette, Yin, Novaria, Sora, Layla, Cici, Vexana, Dyrroth, Freya, Johnson, Yi Sun-shin
C47–49%19Yu Zhong, Aurora, Thamuz, Karrie, Alucard, Claude, Alpha, Kimmy, Gusion, Karina, Selena, Lesley, Chang'e, Harley, Hayabusa, Helcurt, Nana, Martis, Esmeralda
Dbelow 47%9Balmond, Zilong, Gatotkaca, Tigreal, Chou, Lancelot, Granger, Fanny, Franco

Only heroes picked in at least 0.50% of matches are included: rare heroes have noisy win rates from small samples.

A tier here is the win rate only. It ignores hero difficulty and your role: Fanny sits in tier D, but she is one of the hardest heroes, and an average win rate says little about how she plays in experienced hands. If you are confident on a tier C hero, swapping to a tier S hero just for the number makes little sense.

Why Masha and Marcel rank so high

Masha wins 60.47% and Marcel 57.49%. But they are rarely picked and often banned: Masha in 40.76% of matches, Marcel in 41.06%. In Mythical Glory the ban rate rises to 72.71% and 71.47% — strong players keep them out of the match.

Popularity and strength do not match. Hanabi and Obsidia stay above 50% wins, while Tigreal is the most picked tank on the list but wins only 45.20%. Miya and Layla sit just under 50%: new players learn on them, which pulls the number down.

The weakest heroes right now

  • Franco — 41.57% wins at a 0.94% pick rate.
  • Fanny — 42.62% wins at a 0.65% pick rate.
  • Granger — 43.00% wins at a 1.33% pick rate.
  • Lancelot — 43.13% wins at a 0.51% pick rate.
  • Chou — 45.10% wins at a 1.04% pick rate.
  • Tigreal — 45.20% wins at a 2.00% pick rate.

We update this guide once a month and after major patches. The next check comes after Season 43 starts: a balance update usually arrives with it, and the tier list shifts noticeably.
